lines.summary: feat(host-control): computers push events to Deck Apps by long-polling
lines.text: A Deck App for **Host Control**. It lists the computers linked in the VitaDeck Shell with each one's live CPU load, and for the selected one shows its capabilities, CPU and memory gauges from the built-in `systemStats` plugin, an Echo round trip, and the latest notice, which `pnpm --dir js host-companion notify "Hello"` sends and which arrives as an event, without polling.

lines.text: From this repo, `pnpm --dir js host-companion` runs the [Host Companion](../../packages/host-companion/README.md) that `vitadeck-host-companion` installs:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 1. On the computer: `pnpm --dir js host-companion start`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(shell): one LAN Listener for upload and link, on from startup
lines.text: 2. On the computer: `pnpm --dir js host-companion link <vita address>`, with the address the VitaDeck Shell shows under Upload and link.
